{{Top|leg}}
Found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nordra]], the '''NordFeed''' was Nordra's local version of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. Although some of the reports on the NordFeed were openly critical of the policies of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;the ruler of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;NordFeed was not bothered much by the Empire, due to Nordra's isolation.
